name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Ignored, Not Refused: What Low Prompt-Injection Success Rates Hide in Small Tool-Using Agents
items.dek: 76–80% of failed indirect prompt injections are ignored, not refused; ASR alone masks silent bypass and task incompletion.
items.unproven: Generalization beyond 2–14B open-weight models; whether labeled corpus and evaluation framework transfer to proprietary agents the reader may deploy.

items.title: HardEval: An Execution-Verified Benchmark for AI-Driven Security Hardening and Compliance Remediation
items.dek: HardEval benchmark tests whether LLMs can execute RHEL 8 STIG hardening on live systems with OVAL verification.
items.unproven: does not test generalization to other operating systems, custom STIG profiles, or production-scale deployment scenarios

items.title: Monitor-Validity Failures: LLM Safety Evidence Paths at Evolving Framework Boundaries
items.dek: 18 LLM safety framework failures where evidence reaches detectors but disconnects before enforcement decision.
items.unproven: does not quantify prevalence across all deployed frameworks or establish whether fixes remain stable under framework updates

items.title: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
items.dek: MobileInject benchmark tests MLLM-based mobile agents against 108 cross-modal injection attack instances across 11 scenarios.
items.unproven: limited to public MLLM models and does not test against production mobile agent deployments or custom vision fine-tuning

items.title: MobileJailBench: Red Queen Jailbreak Benchmarking for Mobile Agents
items.dek: First jailbreak benchmark for mobile agents with 520 tasks across 14 risk categories and evolving evaluation methodology.
items.unproven: Results on agent families beyond those tested; whether benchmark evolution reflects real-world attack vectors agents will encounter in production.

items.title: Big Fish: Exploiting a 37-Year-Old Kernel Bug in OpenBSD
items.dek: 37-year-old OpenBSD kernel bug exploited; demonstrates longevity of undetected memory safety issues in privileged code.
items.unproven: Scope limited to OpenBSD; does not establish prevalence in other kernels or whether similar patterns persist in reader's deployment targets.

items.title: AgentLoupe: Kernel-Resident Semantic Causal Labels for AI Agent Observability
items.dek: Kernel-resident eBPF tool traces AI agent actions to originating LLM interactions across process boundaries with <8% overhead.
items.unproven: Practical deployment in production SDLC pipelines; whether observability data drives architectural or policy changes; applicability to agents the reader does not run at kernel level.

items.title: I never authorized an integration that scans my secrets
items.dek: GitHub's secret-scanning integration enrolls repositories without explicit user consent, raising audit and compliance questions.
items.unproven: whether the reader's own org has been affected; scope of exposure across customer base

items.title: TUPLE-Bench: Evaluating and Mitigating Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in Typed Decision Models
items.dek: Benchmark shows 92-100% of classification models leak fine-grained causes through confidence scores and candidate sets.
items.unproven: does not establish whether recipients can exploit these leaks in realistic threat models or how WCPQ performs under adaptive attacks

items.title: Electrostatic Limits on Quantum Spatial Search
items.dek: Quantum spatial search on 2D lattices requires Ω(√(N log N)) steps, not Grover's O(√N), via electrostatic bounds.
items.unproven: practical quantum hardware implications; relevance to post-quantum migration or agent security

items.title: From Billion-Scale to Million-Scale Language Models: Operational Capabilities for Embedded Post-Exploitation
items.dek: Evaluation of 20M-1.5B parameter SLMs shows 1.5B models reach 100% Pass@5 on backdoor and directory enumeration code generation.
items.unproven: does not test execution on real defended systems, patching latency, or detection evasion in operational environments

items.title: Unconditional Quantum PAC Learning Advantage in the Large Error Regime
items.dek: Unconditional super-polynomial separation between quantum and classical PAC learners in large error regime established.
items.unproven: Practical relevance to Boolean function classes of interest, sample complexity in realistic learning scenarios, hardness of classical learner proved.

items.title: Bad Diagnosis: Analyzing Consent and Data Collection Practices of Mobile Medical Apps
items.dek: Survey of 10,000+ mHealth apps finds 69% request unrelated permissions and 93% lack consent forms.
items.unproven: does not establish what fraction of permission requests pose actual data exfiltration risk or how many apps have legitimate but undocumented use cases

items.title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
items.dek: ABF-Bench creates verifiable agent tasks for blockchain fund tracing using real laundering cases and ledger evidence.
items.unproven: does not address forensic tasks beyond transfer tracing or evaluate against adversarial evasion tactics deployed post-publication

items.title: Delta-sigma noise shaping for low-resolution quantization in Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable quantum key distribution
items.dek: Delta-sigma modulation achieves 97% of reference key rate with 4-bit quantization in CVQKD systems over 20 km.
items.unproven: single testbed deployment; no evidence this addresses deployment challenges or migration planning for financial services infrastructure

items.title: Token-Level Attribution of Multi-Mode LLM Watermarks: Optimal Rule and Belief Weighting
items.dek: BLADE detector assigns multi-mode LLM watermarks to tokens by optimizing power under Type I error constraints.
items.unproven: does not test robustness against adversarial watermark removal or deployment at scale across diverse model families

items.title: Improving the estimation of spin-bath parameters via initial correlations and a two-qubit probe
items.dek: Two-qubit probes improve spin-bath parameter estimation by factors of 3–8 under initial correlations.
items.unproven: experimental validation; relevance to security engineering or agent/PQC workflows

items.title: Holographic two-point functions across a PT symmetry-breaking transition
items.dek: Two-point functions in holographic models exhibit log-periodic oscillations across PT-symmetry transitions.
items.unproven: any relevance to application security, SDLC process, or architectural risk

items.title: Action-Quantized Scar Multiplets and Dissipative Cat States from Fractal Period-Locking in the Open Quantum Baker Map
items.dek: Open quantum baker map with position window produces quantized scar multiplets and cat states.
items.unproven: scalability; connection to security engineering or classical/quantum hybrid systems the reader operates

items.title: Solving Large-Scale Parameter Inference in Controllable Nuclear Fusion via Coherent Ising Machines and Block Coordinate Descent
items.dek: Coherent Ising Machine solves tokamak plasma inversion in ~1 ms; block-wise scheme prevents real-time control today.
items.unproven: applicability to financial services security engineering; relevance to tooling decisions or process

items.title: Cayley access models for matrix functions: reachable class and cost
items.dek: Cayley transform reduces polynomial degree 3–4× for matrix functions on quantum computers when spectral difficulty is localized.
items.unproven: practical implementation on current quantum hardware; connection to reader's security architecture or tooling

items.title: ConQUESTA: Topology-Aware Post-Training Structural Pruning of Quantum Neural Networks
items.dek: ConQUESTA prunes QNNs post-training with topology-aware transpilation, reducing two-qubit gates 61–82% across benchmarks.
items.unproven: deployment on hardware with practical constraints; relevance to agent security in SDLC or production systems

items.title: Quantum Circuits for Variable-Coefficient Vlasov Dynamics via Schrödingerisation
items.dek: Quantum circuit implementation for Vlasov dynamics shows linear resource scaling with time steps on proof-of-concept six-dimensional system.
items.unproven: Scalability beyond 3D3V phase space, practical advantage over classical methods, fault-tolerance requirements for real hardware.

items.title: Bell scenarios encode classical non-causality
items.dek: Bell scenario measurements correspond to non-causal classical communication protocols; abstract mathematical connection.
items.unproven: Experimental relevance, practical application to Bell test design or violation bounds.

items.title: On the (In)stability of Adaptive Fee Mechanisms in Multi-Chain Systems
items.dek: Control-theoretic analysis shows cross-chain fee coupling reduces adaptive fee mechanism stability versus monolithic blockchains.
items.unproven: does not propose practical parameter recommendations for deployed systems or model real market conditions beyond synthetic scenarios

noise.title: OpenCode Hacked: User credentials leaked
noise.dek: Credential breach at OpenCode reported via social media; no technical detail, scope, or remediation path given.
noise.unproven: identity of affected users, nature of credentials, whether the reader's org uses OpenCode, timeline, or mitigation steps

noise.title: Anthropic's proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1B in damages
noise.dek: Policy proposal from Anthropic sets liability thresholds for AI systems; outside application security engineer's scope.
noise.unproven: outside the reader's remit; does not affect SDLC process, tooling, or architecture review

noise.title: Source code of the Estonian online voting system
noise.dek: Estonian e-voting system source code made public; outside reader's SDLC scope and governance domain.
noise.unproven: applicability to financial services application security; reader does not audit voting infrastructure
